Sends custom headers on same-host crawl requests

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"custom_headers\":{\"Accept-Language\":\"en-US\",\"X-Custom-Header\":\"test-value\"},\"max_depth\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":false,\"subdomain_header_allowlist\":[\"Accept-Language\"]}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.crawl(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.pages().count)
```
